items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No personal interaction with Earl Hines is described; the interviewee discusses Hines's band in the context of other musicians (King Kolax, Dizzy Gillespie) and Chicago jazz history.

ctx.x: What about [King] Kolax? All that came in later?
No. Kolax come along about the same time as Earl Hines, because when Earl Hines left the Grand Terrace, Kolax went in with his big band.
So you’re talking about early ’40s to mid-’40s.
